title: Hearty Molten Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A sweet and nostalgic Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, fines herbes, and a molten center, served on a hot stone plate. This recipe combines the flavors of the Middle East with a unique cooking method.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, fines herbes, garlic, ginger, pomegranate molasses, salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a hot stone plate or in the tandoor and cook for 15 minutes, turning occasionally.
Reduce the heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the center is molten.
Serve the lamb kebabs on the hot stone plate, garnished with additional fines herbes and sumac if desired.
Caution: the hot stone plate will be extremely hot, so use tongs or a towel to handle it.
